_comment: One entry per customer tenant: which warehouse connection + KPI catalog it uses, and display settings.
_comment_alerts: Optional per tenant (v9): "alerts": {"disabled": [rule ids], "params": {rule id: {threshold: value}}}. Rule ids and default thresholds are in vdash/catalog/<catalog>.py (RULES).
_comment_talk: Optional per tenant (Step 5): "talk_to_data": false switches the built-in Talk to Data chat off for this business (the menu entry disappears or falls back to the settings.json link). Missing = on whenever config/ask_chat.json is enabled.
_comment_plan: Optional per tenant (v34): "plan": one of config/report_plans.json (trial, starter, growth, pro, enterprise) - sets the monthly report limit. Missing = default_plan.

alerts._comment: Historical demo data (ends Feb 2026): the 'no new data' warning would always fire, so it is off here.
